summary: All four blocking findings are valid and should be repaired in spec.json: completion contract owner, stale-check basis, out-of-scope/flaky criteria, and fix-attempt recommendation state.

items.title: Completion contract target is missing for failed-recorded advancement
items.rationale: The review identifies an existing completion policy owner that must allow the new failed-recorded completion state.
items.evidence: src/flow/lib/flow-judgment-contract.js currently defines final-regression completion policy with failureKind null and nextAction finalize-commit; registry post-hook uses step completion validation.

items.title: Stale artifact rejection has no observable validation basis
items.rationale: The spec must define durable evidence and comparison rules so implementation and tests can distinguish current failed evidence from stale failed evidence.
items.evidence: R5 requires stale rejection but current spec does not define command identity or changed-file fingerprint comparison for record-and-proceed.

items.title: Out-of-scope and flaky classification criteria are undefined
items.rationale: The spec should either define source-backed category criteria or narrow automatic classification to categories with current evidence.
items.evidence: Existing classification inputs are command/discovery errors, process output, timeout/signal/exit status, changed-file references, and classifyRegression change scope.

items.title: Fix-attempt recommendation state has no data path
items.target: R4 / R7 / Data Flow: Auto/manual behavior
items.rationale: The recommendation order and auto behavior need a persisted fix-attempt signal to be deterministic and testable.
items.evidence: Existing code can count prior final-regression issue-log failures but does not distinguish repair attempts from repeated reruns.
